query_subset: all frozen heldout demonstration frames; deterministic preprocessing
limitations: Post-hoc offline diagnostics, not a new policy or rollout. Full block state is used only to measure errors and construct an explicitly privileged geometry reference, never fed to ALT. Expert action difference is descriptive, not a unique correct-action label. Swapped image/position pairs are artificial sensitivity probes. No binary accuracy/success/OOD threshold or training setting is introduced.
